CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2772 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head b1cba1acab22009ca5eb2de99237d8f421d05dca. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch b1cba1acab22009ca5eb2de99237d8f421d05dca for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-train-upgrade-r2, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-train-upgrade-r2 <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-train-upgrade-r2; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

(`gate` also printed "still being judged"; that is the codeql/gate race, not yours.)

Merge origin/main, re-take every figure the body states, and run tools/pr/prepr.sh with BASH_ENV unset before the handoff.

No host or home paths in anything you push (cite repo-relative paths only). Do not end the turn while a background job runs.
